dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Basement
呼啸山庄 地下室

dataList.content:
Dammit, I see now. It was you. It was you all along!
妈的，这样啊。原来是你。原来连那也是你！

No, it was always like this.
不，一直都是这样的。

I was surrounded by those opportunistic, backstabbing fuckers whose only goals were to suck my fortune dry...
我周围总是些盯着我背后，虎视眈眈地准备捅刀子的混蛋……

There never was a place for me.
这里从未有过我的立足之地。

Not even in here, this vast manor of Wuthering Heights.
呼啸山庄……即便是在这座宽敞的宅邸里。

WHY? It's that bloody vagabond who invaded our home! Why... why should I be subject to such—
为什么？那个该死的乞丐才是我们家的入侵者！啧……为什么受到这种待遇的是我……

... Huh? Who's that...?!
……哈？那是谁……？

Hindley begins flailing his arms at nothing, then speaks into the void.
亨德利突然向空中挥动着手臂，开始对着无人的地方说道。

Yes, exactly, you understand...! All I wanted...
没错，如你所言……我只是……

... all I wanted was a small, fancy violin. That's all it was. But he tossed me to the mud pits in the rain like I was a rabid dog...
我只是想要一把……小小的、像样的小提琴而已……但自己却像一条病犬般，被抛弃在雨中的泥泞里……

Yes! I remember every single word of what my father told me! OF COURSE I DO! I can even recite it from the top of my head!
对了，我还清楚地记得父亲对我说的每个字！当然记得！要我大声说给你听吗？

<He's distorting...>
<扭曲……>

Hindley!!! I regret that I cannot bring myself to consider a reprobate like you as my own child. That boy, Heathcliff, is more like my son than you shall ever be! HAHAHAHA!!!
亨德利！！！讲句抱歉的话，我没法把你当作我的孩子。不如说那个希斯克利夫才更像是我的孩子！哈哈哈！！！

All those who found themselves at the edge of suffering, as my old fellow Dongrang had...
他就像我的旧友东朗……一样，在逼近各自的苦痛尽头之时……

... muttered aught to themselves. As though they were conversing with an invisible partner.
都如同在和看不见的人聊天般自言自语。

Then...
之后……

<Meursault, can you stop this, like you did last time?>
<默尔索，你能像之前那样阻止他吗？>

It is impossible. I am attempting to approach him, yet I feel an equal force pushing me in the opposite direction.
不可能。我试着靠近他，但感到被一股同等的力量推了回来。

... Unlike the case with the Monolith, this is a Distortion occurring as it normally should. Faust explains that such Distortions occur as though it has been ordained by fate itself. Once the sequence has started, it cannot be stopped without a strong will from the subject of Distortion.
……与独石那一次不同，这次是正常产生的扭曲。浮士德认为，扭曲就像是必然一般开始并进行。如果没有扭曲主体自身的强烈意志，仅仅进行物理干预的话，是无法在事前阻止这种现象发生的。

<Then...>
<也就是说……>

... Yes. He will Distort.
……此为他将展现扭曲的表现。

Yes. Yes... Of course.
是的，是的……正是如此。

I have no reason to protect Wuthering Heights anymore. Not a single one!
我没有任何理由再守护呼啸山庄了。一个也没有了！

This place that never once welcomed me... This 'home'...
这个地方一次也没有欢迎过我……在这个家中……

Can't you see? Wuthering Heights is rotting away.
你看不到吗？呼啸山庄正在腐烂。

This sickening, rotting stench that penetrates your nostrils! Gah... Can't you feel it? This rot?!
这股刺鼻的、腐烂的恶臭！咕唔……你感觉不到吗？这股恶臭！

You...
你……

Hahaha... this isn't much of a surprise, is it? It has absorbed so much hatred over the years.
哈哈……因为这里凝聚着一切的憎恶，所以也没什么好惊讶的。对吧。

Even Catherine must have hated me as she expired.
凯瑟琳即使在死后也一定会对我恨之入骨吧。

So...
那么……所以啊。

Wuthering Heights, this decaying manor... must crumble.
呼啸山庄就从此腐朽崩塌吧。

It is simply as it should be... haha!
没什么好惊讶的吧……哈哈！
